00030 #include "ugen_vfp_clobbers.h"

00032 // Usage for any VFP routine is:
00033 
00034 /*
00035     asm volatile (VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM
00036 
00037                   <--  your code goes here
00038 
00039                   VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB
00040                   : <list of modified INPUT registers>
00041                   : <list of input registers>
00042                   : "r0", <additional registers you used>
00043                   );
00044 */
00045 
00046 // NOTE: Lots of VFP macros overwrite register r0, therefore you have to make sure 
00047 //       to include "r0" in the list of registers used, as in above example.
00048 
00049 //#define USE_THUMB
00050   
00051 
00052 
00053 //#define ASM_WRAPPER_R0(x)   asm volatile (x : : : "r0" );
00054 //#define ASM_WRAPPER_R0_PC(x)  asm volatile (x : : : "r0", "pc" );
00055   
00056 
00057 // Switches to from THUMB to ARM mode.
00058 #ifdef USE_THUMB
00059   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM ".align 4               \n\t" \
00060                 "mov     r0, pc         \n\t" \
00061                 "bx      r0             \n\t" \
00062                 ".arm                   \n\t" 
00063   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM asm volatile(VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM : : : "r0", "pc");
00064 #else
00065   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM  ""
00066   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM asm volatile(VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM : : : VFP_CLOBBER_S0_S31)
00067 #endif
00068 
00069 
00070 // Switches from ARM to THUMB mode.
00071 #ifdef USE_THUMB
00072   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB "ssadd     r0, pc, #1     \n\t" \
00073                 "bx      r0             \n\t" \
00074                 ".thumb                 \n\t" 
00075   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM asm volatile(VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB : : : "r0", "pc");
00076 #else
00077   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB  ""
00078   #define VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM asm volatile(VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB : : : VFP_CLOBBER_S0_S31)
00079 #endif

00082 // NOTE: Both VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH* macros will stall the FP unit, 
00083 //       until all currently processed operations have been executed.
00084 //       Call wisely.
00085 //       FP operations (except load/stores) will interpret a command like
00086 //   fadds s8, s16, s24
00087 //   AS
00088 //   fadds {s8-s11}, {s16-s19}, {s24-s27} in case length is set to zero.
00089 
00090 
00091 // Sets length and stride to 0.
00092 #define VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO "fmrx    r0, fpscr            \n\t" \
00093                                "bic     r0, r0, #0x00370000  \n\t" \
00094                                "fmxr    fpscr, r0            \n\t" 
00095 #define VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM asm volatile (VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO : : : "r0");
00096   
00097 
00098 
00099 // Set vector length. VEC_LENGTH has to be bitween 0 for length 1 and 3 for length 4.
00100 #define VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH(VEC_LENGTH) "fmrx    r0, fpscr                         \n\t" \
00101                                       "bic     r0, r0, #0x00370000               \n\t" \
00102                                       "orr     r0, r0, #0x000" #VEC_LENGTH "0000 \n\t" \
00103                                       "fmxr    fpscr, r0                         \n\t"
00104 #define VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(VEC_LENGTH) asm volatile (VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH(VEC_LENGTH) : : : "r0");
00105

00107 // Fixed vector operation for vectors of length 1, i.e. scalars.
00108 // Expects pointers to source and destination data.
00109 // Use VFP_OP_* macros for VFP_OP or any FP assembler opcode that fits.
00110 #define VFP_FIXED_1_VECTOR_OP(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00111   asm volatile (  VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM \
00112           "fldmias  %1, {s8}        \n\t" \
00113           "fldmias  %2, {s16}       \n\t" \
00114           VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00115           "fstmias  %0, {s8}        \n\t" \
00116           VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB \
00117           : \
00118           : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00119           : "r0", "pc", "memory", "s8", "s16" \
00120           );
00121 
00122 #define VFP_FIXED_1_UNARY_OP3(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_DST) \
00123   asm volatile (  "fldmias  %1, {s8}        \n\t" \
00124           VFP_OP  " s8, s8      \n\t" \
00125           "fstmias  %0, {s8}        \n\t" \
00126           : \
00127           : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1) \
00128           : "memory", "s8" \
00129           );
00130 
00131 #define VFP_FIXED_1_UNARY_OP4(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_DST) \
00132   asm volatile (  "fldmias  %1!, {s8}        \n\t" \
00133           VFP_OP  " s8, s8      \n\t" \
00134           "fstmias  %0!, {s8}        \n\t" \
00135           : "=r" (P_DST), "=r" (P_SRC_1) \
00136           : "0" (P_DST), "1" (P_SRC_1) \
00137           : "memory", "s8" \
00138           );
00139

00142 // Fixed vector operation for vectors of length 2, i.e. scalars.
00143 // Expects pointers to source and destination data.
00144 // Use VFP_OP_* macros for VFP_OP or any FP assembler opcode that fits.
00145 #define VFP_FIXED_2_VECTOR_OP(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00146   asm volatile (VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM \
00147                 "fldmias  %1, {s8-s9}   \n\t" \
00148                 "fldmias  %2, {s16-s17} \n\t" \
00149                 VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00150                 VFP_OP  " s9, s9, s17   \n\t" \
00151                 "fstmias  %0, {s8-s9}   \n\t" \
00152                 VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB \
00153                 : \
00154                 : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00155                 : "r0", "pc", "memory" \
00156                 );
00157 
00158 // Fixed vector operation for vectors of length 3, i.e. scalars.
00159 // Expects pointers to source and destination data.
00160 // Use VFP_OP_* macros for VFP_OP or any FP assembler opcode that fits.
00161 #define VFP_FIXED_3_VECTOR_OP(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00162   asm volatile (VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM \
00163                 "fldmias  %1, {s8-s10}  \n\t" \
00164                 "fldmias  %2, {s16-s18} \n\t" \
00165                 VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00166                 VFP_OP  " s9, s9, s17   \n\t" \
00167                 VFP_OP  " s10, s10, s18 \n\t" \
00168                 "fstmias  %0, {s8-s10}   \n\t" \
00169                 VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB \
00170                 : \
00171                 : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00172                 : "r0", "cc", "pc", "memory", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S10, VFP_CLOBBER_S16_S18 \
00173                 );
00174 
00175 // Fixed vector operation for vectors of length 4, i.e. scalars.
00176 // Expects pointers to source and destination data.
00177 // Use VFP_OP_* macros for VFP_OP or any FP assembler opcode that fits.
00178 #define VFP_FIXED_4_VECTOR_OP(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00179   asm volatile (VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM \
00180                 "fldmias  %1, {s8-s11}  \n\t" \
00181                 "fldmias  %2, {s16-s19} \n\t" \
00182                 VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00183                 VFP_OP  " s9, s9, s17   \n\t" \
00184                 VFP_OP  " s10, s10, s18 \n\t" \
00185                 VFP_OP  " s11, s11, s19 \n\t" \
00186                 "fstmias  %0, {s8-s11}   \n\t" \
00187                 VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB \
00188                 : \
00189                 : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00190                 : "r0", "cc", "pc", "memory", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S11, VFP_CLOBBER_S16_S19 \
00191                 );
00192 
00193 // suffixes:
00194 // OP2 doesn't call VFP_OP multiple times
00195 // OP3 as OP2 but also doesn't set/reset the thumb/arm status
00196 // OP4 as OP3 but also increments the buffer pointers
00197 // so e.g., VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP4 is fastest here
00198 
00199 #define VFP_FIXED_4_VECTOR_OP2(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00200   asm volatile (  VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM       \
00201           "fldmias  %1, {s8-s11}  \n\t" \
00202           "fldmias  %2, {s16-s19} \n\t" \
00203           VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00204           "fstmias  %0, {s8-s11}   \n\t"  \
00205           VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB       \
00206           : \
00207           : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00208           : "r0", "cc", "pc", "memory", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S11, VFP_CLOBBER_S16_S19 \
00209           );
00210 
00211 #define VFP_FIXED_4_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP, P_SRC_1, P_SRC_2, P_DST) \
00212   asm volatile (  "fldmias  %1, {s8-s11}  \n\t" \
00213           "fldmias  %2, {s16-s19} \n\t" \
00214           VFP_OP  " s8, s8, s16   \n\t" \
00215           "fstmias  %0, {s8-s11}   \n\t"  \
00216           : \
00217           : "r" (P_DST), "r" (P_SRC_1), "r" (P_SRC_2) \
00218           : "r0", "cc", "memory", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S11, VFP_CLOBBER_S16_S19 \
00219           );
00220

00226           : "=r" (P_DST), "=r" (P_SRC_1), "=r" (P_SRC_2) \
00227           : "0" (P_DST), "1" (P_SRC_1), "2" (P_SRC_2) \
00228           : "r0", "cc", "memory", VFP_CLOBBER_S8_S11, VFP_CLOBBER_S16_S19 \
